posterior_predictive_agbd_check.note: Cross-checked per stratum against GEDI L4A AGBD where available -- see structural_strata in asset-structural-evidence-v3.json for per-stratum gedi_l4a_agbd_mean_mg_ha. A full quantitative reconciliation (implied-biomass-vs-AGBD ratio feeding an explicit uncertainty inflation) was scoped but the very small per-stratum L4A shot counts (1-6 shots per asset) made a stable per-stratum ratio unreliable this pass -- reported as a qualitative diagnostic only, not used to silently narrow or widen the reported posterior.

tree_population_state.method_note: Importance-sampling (ABC) posterior per (stratum x candidate material class), Bayesian-model-averaged by real ABC evidence, aggregated to asset level via per-draw SUMMED totals (stems/BA/volume) and area-weighted MIXTURE draws (DBH/height) -- never sum-of-quantiles, never independent-quantile multiplication. See app/services/tree_population_model.py for priors, forward model and likelihood.

market_state.note: Country-gated by real point-in-country geocoding (not a distance proxy). Priced via the versioned evidence hierarchy (best available: COUNTRY_PRODUCT_BENCHMARK) -- see each record's evidence_class/source/note. netback remains a P50-scalar broadcast across draws (not a full joint per-draw netback across zones/processors).

volume_state.volume_by_year_note: 2024/2025 RETROSPECTIVE MODEL ESTIMATES, 2026 current MODELLED posterior, 2027/2028 MODEL PROJECTIONS. net-stock-change prior mean=-0.010 (Only 1 real NDVI observation(s) -- too few for any trend; net-stock-change mean left at the flat ASSUMED prior.) -- still NOT a Landsat/S1/S2 state-space backcast.

valuation_state.option_value_method_note: Discrete 2026-2028 WAIT/HARVEST dynamic program, backward-induced via cross-sectional mean continuation value (not a state-dependent regression -- a first implementation, not a full continuous-state solver), 8% real discount rate (ASSUMED, not measured for these assets), 4000 resampled paths per year from the existing volume/netback posteriors (years resampled independently, so any real cross-year persistence in price or growth shocks beyond what those posteriors already encode is not captured). asset_option_value_usd is expressed in the first horizon year's terms. Volume-if-unharvested growth rate: ASSUMED 4% +/- 2% (clipped to 0-10%) annual increment -- a generic positive-growth assumption, deliberately NOT the same as the net-stock-change depletion prior used for the status-quo volume_by_year series above (conflating the two would make 'wait' always look at least as bad as 'harvest now').
valuation_state.note: harvest_margin_usd may be NEGATIVE and reflects only today's forced-liquidation payoff. asset_option_value_usd is the value of the OPTIMAL wait/harvest policy over 2026-2028 -- this, not harvest_margin_usd, is the headline asset value. A negative harvest margin under current prices does NOT mean the biological asset has negative value; it means immediate harvest is not the optimal action.
